tools.name: solidtime_get_current_user
tools.description: Return the signed-in solidtime user: id, name, email, timezone and week start. Use it to check the connection. solidtime API: GET /v1/users/me.

tools.name: solidtime_list_organizations
tools.description: List the organizations (workspaces) you belong to, with your role. Each item's id is the member_id for time entries in that organization. solidtime API: GET /v1/users/me/memberships.

tools.name: solidtime_get_active_timer
tools.description: Return the time entry that is running now (no end time), or say that no timer runs. solidtime API: GET /v1/users/me/time-entries/active.

tools.name: solidtime_list_projects
tools.description: List projects in an organization. Archived projects are hidden unless archived is true or all. solidtime API: GET /v1/organizations/{organization}/projects.

tools.name: solidtime_get_project
tools.description: Return one project: name, client, billable flag, estimated and spent time. solidtime API: GET /v1/organizations/{organization}/projects/{project}.

tools.name: solidtime_list_clients
tools.description: List clients in an organization. solidtime API: GET /v1/organizations/{organization}/clients.

tools.name: solidtime_list_tags
tools.description: List tags in an organization. Use the tag ids in time entries. solidtime API: GET /v1/organizations/{organization}/tags.

tools.name: solidtime_list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks in an organization, optionally for one project. Done tasks are hidden unless done is true or all. solidtime API: GET /v1/organizations/{organization}/tasks.

tools.name: solidtime_list_time_entries
tools.description: List time entries in an organization, newest first. Filter by member, time window, running or billable state. At most 500 per call; use offset to page. solidtime API: GET /v1/organizations/{organization}/time-entries.

tools.name: solidtime_start_timer
tools.description: Start a timer now for a member. The API refuses a second running timer (time_entry_still_running), so stop the running timer first with solidtime_stop_timer. solidtime API: POST /v1/organizations/{organization}/time-entries.

tools.name: solidtime_stop_timer
tools.description: Stop the timer that runs now, setting its end to the current UTC time. Fails when no timer runs. Reads the running entry first, then updates it. solidtime API: GET /v1/users/me/time-entries/active, PUT /v1/organizations/{organization}/time-entries/{timeEntry}.

tools.name: solidtime_create_time_entry
tools.description: Log a finished time entry with a start and an end, for a member. Use solidtime_start_timer for a running one. solidtime API: POST /v1/organizations/{organization}/time-entries.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: solidtime_get_current_user · Public sink: solidtime_get_current_user, solidtime_start_timer, solidtime_create_time_entry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: solidtime_get_current_user · Public sink: solidtime_get_current_user, solidtime_start_timer, solidtime_create_time_entry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
